setlist.title: Beat It On Down The Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls it one of the longest Bird Songs ever; Reviewer highlights an extended Bird Song in the first set [13][14][17]
- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): Reviewer finds this version rhythmic and haunting, going to some nice places; Reviewer ranks this Dark Star among the best heard, top 20 but below 3-1-69 [9][12][13]
- **Deal** (2 reviews): Reviewer recommends listening to Keith after the first instrumental break; Reviewer praises Bobby's playing and his interplay with Jerry here [17][18]
- **Promised Land** (1 review): Reviewer finds Promised Land a letdown and suggests skipping to Deal [17]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer names Sugaree as another highlight [18]
- **Playing in the Band** (1 review): Reviewer describes Playin' as lengthy and mysterious [10]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the He's Gone into Truckin' pairing as outstanding [10]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer calls Jack Straw tremendous [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-09-10.163863.sbd.miller.gems.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 216 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd72-09-10.sbd.patched.greenberg-powell.22793.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 198 min; rated 4.72/5 by 18 [2]
- **gd72-09-10.sbd.winters.17690.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 180 min; rated 4.31/5 by 13 [3]. Said about its sound: Sound is acceptable with few cuts; the Bertha intro appears to be missing; Recording is acceptable but not outstanding, rated about three and a half stars; Soundboard sounds crisp yet warm, typical of early 1970s recordings [7][9][10][14]
- **gd1972-09-10.sbd.lai.5679.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 4.29/5 by 7 [4]. Said about its sound: Lists numerous pops, static, glitches and skips; one late track has worsening repetitive soft clicking [4]
- **gd1972-09-10.sbd.vernon.5680.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [5]

## Around the show

- David Crosby guests from the Dark Star segment through the end of the second set [7]
- David Crosby joins the band at Dark Star and stays until the show closes, with no encore [11]
- David Crosby plays guitar and sings on Dark Star, Jack Straw, Sing Me Back Home and Sugar Magnolia [1]
- David Crosby plays guitar on Beat It On Down The Line [4]
- David Crosby plays guitar on Beat It On Down The Line [5]
- Reviewer sets it against an epic 8/27 show and the uneven July shows after Pigpen's loss, calling it a week-later recovery [8]
- Reviewer suggests fans of 8-21 and 7-29 in 1972 will like this show [11]
- Reviewer notes Deadbase ranks the show only 486th despite how good it sounds [12]
- Jam before Jack Straw resembles the post-Truckin' jam and the spot where Other One falls on Europe '72 [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-09-10.163863.sbd.miller.gems.flac16**: transferred by Mastered by Jim Blackwood Speed/pitch adjusted by Jason Chastain Track, FLAC, and pack by Steve Gravel; source: Vault master SBD reel source (with assumed DAT generation) provided by Charlie Miller [1]. Also: Patched with a circulating soundboard in Bird Song, Sugaree, Playing in the Band, Ramble On Rose and Dark Star [1]
- **gd72-09-10.sbd.patched.greenberg-powell.22793.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: This patched version includes the final two songs and fixes many cuts present in the other source; Taped as MSR, patched from another MSR copy; patches and remaster by Dave Greenberg [2][11]
- **gd72-09-10.sbd.winters.17690.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1972-09-10.sbd.lai.5679.shnf**: transferred by Mike Lai; source: SBD > [MR > C > DAT(s) ??] > CDR(s) > DAE > SHN [4]
- **gd1972-09-10.sbd.vernon.5680.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Matt Vernon; source: SBD > [MR > C > DAT(s) ??] > CDR(s) > EAC > SHN > SHNTOOL (fix sector boundaries by sets) > mkwact (seekable) [5]. Also: Based on Mike Lai's original shn files, with track boundary issues fixed and seektables added [5]
